content:
A woman who claims to have had a romantic relationship with former "American Idol" contestant and pastor Caleb Flynn, who is accused of killing his wife Ashley Flynn, has revealed shocking new details about their alleged relationship.

Alleigha Botner took the stand on Wednesday and Thursday in Miami County, Ohio, during Flynn's trial. During her testimony on Thursday, the 24-year-old read aloud text messages she says were sent to her by 40-year-old Caleb Flynn. In some of the messages, Caleb Flynn expressed wanting his wife to "disappear," even if it meant "destroying my daughters' lives."

"You know I hate her," Caleb Flynn wrote in one of the messages about Ashley Flynn, footage obtained by local NBC affiliate WLWT shows. "I can't stand to see her or hear her name."

Botner's testimony became especially emotional when she read a particularly chilling exchange.

"I really wish I had never said this," she told the court, before reading a message she sent to Caleb Flynn: "I want to kill her, Caleb."

Caleb Flynn's reply, she said, was: "He said, 'So we both feel that way.'"

Botner, now a marketing specialist, said she met Caleb Flynn in 2022 while she was an intern at their church.

Below is a portion of Botner's testimony as aired by WLWT.

Although she knew Caleb Flynn was married and had even met his wife, she claims their sexual relationship began in May 2024.

Botner said she and Caleb Flynn were discussing their future together up until Feb. 15 — the day before Ashley Flynn's death, according to WLWT.

"Alleigha, I love you, and if you give me one more chance, I will love you until the day I die," Flynn wrote in a text that day, according to Botner, who added: "He said, 'I choose you, Alleigha. You're enough. Good night.'"

Ashley Flynn, 37, was found shot multiple times on Feb. 16 inside the Tipp City, Ohio, home she shared with Caleb Flynn. Their daughters, then 9 and 11, were asleep at the time.

Authorities were summoned to the scene by Caleb Flynn, who told a 911 dispatcher that someone had broken into the home in the middle of the night and killed his wife.

Caleb Flynn was arrested three days later and charged with murder, two counts of felonious assault and two counts of tampering with evidence. He has pleaded not guilty to all charges.

Caleb Flynn, a native of Ohio, had a brief stint on season 12 of "American Idol" in 2013. He was eliminated early in the competition, before the televised rounds.

A short interview with Caleb Flynn can be found on the official "American Idol" YouTube account. In the interview, he says he loves his wife "more than anything" and that Carrie Underwood is his favorite "Idol" winner.
